initial_plan.can_answer: yes, for the distribution of police-reported crashes by weekday in records dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; not crash risk per trip or traffic exposure
initial_plan.metric: crash count by weekday and each weekday's share of all included crashes
initial_plan.denominator: all crashes with a nonmissing crash_date in 2013-2025
initial_plan.population: one police-reported motor vehicle crash per row, with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
filters: crash_date in 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; missing crash_date excluded because it has no weekday
initial_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check_findings.rows: 2,132,218 rows in the planned population; per-year row counts are in check_1.csv
data_check_findings.crash_date_quality: 0 missing crash_date rows in the file and 0 rows at the checked sentinel dates 0001-01-01, 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, and 9999-12-31
data_check_findings.year_coverage: Each year 2013-2025 has rows on both January 1 and December 31; endpoint presence does not establish that every intervening date is represented.
data_check_findings.effect_and_decision: No rows are excluded for a missing or sentinel date; all dated rows in the selected years receive a weekday and count once. Keep all planned rows; no separate missing-date group is needed.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, for the distribution of police-reported crashes by weekday in the available records dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; the data do not measure traffic exposure or crashes per trip
final_plan.metric: number of crashes by weekday and weekday share = that weekday's crashes divided by all included crashes
final_plan.population: one police-reported motor vehicle crash per row with a nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
filters: crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive; no other filters
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; all have observed records at both calendar-year endpoints, though internal date coverage is not verified
final_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, ordered Monday through Sunday
final_plan.limitations: Police-reported crash records are counts, not exposure-adjusted risk. There are no missing dates or checked sentinel dates; all selected years span their first and last calendar days, but the check does not prove complete reporting on every intervening date.
